Muammal ba-ma'ani aur mehmal be-ma'ani hota hai
explanation: Muammal = ba-ma'ani lafz (kalma); mehmal = be-ma'ani lafz.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Roti-shoti kha lo' mein 'shoti' qawaid ki ro se kya hai?
explanation: 'Shoti' ka koi ma'ani nahin, is liye mehmal hai.

subject: Urdu
q: Lafz 'aur' kalma ki kaun si qism hai?
explanation: 'Aur' do lafzon ko jorta hai aur khud mukammal ma'ani nahin deta - harf hai.

subject: Urdu
q: Lafz 'daurta hai' kalma ki kaun si qism hai?
explanation: 'Daurta hai' kaam ko zamane mein batata hai - fe'l hai.

subject: Urdu
q: Ism ki durust tareef kaun si hai?
options: Kaam ko zamane mein batane wala lafz
Wo ba-ma'ani lafz jo kisi shakhs, cheez, jagah ya sifat ka naam bataye aur apne ma'ani mein khud mukammal ho
explanation: Ism apne ma'ani mein khud mukammal hota hai; harf doosre ka mohtaj hota hai.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Lahore', 'Quaid-e-Azam' aur 'Ravi' ism ki kaun si qism ki misalein hain?
explanation: Ye khaas aur mutayyan naam hain - ism-e-ma'rifa.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Sheher', 'larka' aur 'darya' ism ki kaun si qism hain?
explanation: Ye aam aur ghair-mutayyan naam hain - ism-e-nakra.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Acha', 'bura', 'lamba' ism ki kaun si qism hain?
explanation: Ye khubi/kharabi batate hain - ism-e-sifat.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Mein, tum, wo, hum, aap' qawaid ki ro se kya kehlate hain?
explanation: Ye ism ki jagah istemal hote hain - ism-e-zameer.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Ye, wo, yeh, woh' kya hain?
explanation: Ye ishare ke liye istemal hote hain - ism-e-ishaara.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Kaun, kya, kab, kahan, kaise' kya kehlate hain?
explanation: Ye sawal pochne wale alfaaz hain - ism-e-istifham.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Jo, jis, jise, jinhon ne' qawaid ki ro se kya hain?
explanation: Ye do jumlon ko jorte hain - ism-e-mausool.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Jo mehnat karta hai, kamyab hota hai' mein 'jo' kya hai?
explanation: 'Jo' do jumlon ko jor raha hai - ism-e-mausool.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Sachchai', 'bahaduri', 'mohabbat' ism ki kaun si qism ki misalein hain?
explanation: Ye ghair-mahsoos cheezon ke naam hain - ism-e-ma'na.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Darakht', 'mez', 'kitab' ism ki kaun si qism hain?
explanation: Ye khud maujood cheezon ke naam hain - ism-e-zat.

subject: Urdu
q: Ism-e-Ma'rifa ki pehchan kya hai?
options: Khaas aur mutayyan shakhs, cheez ya jagah ka naam ho
explanation: Ma'rifa khaas naam hota hai, nakra aam naam.

subject: Urdu
q: Darj zeel mein Ism-e-Sifat kaun sa hai?
explanation: 'Zaheen' khubi batata hai - ism-e-sifat.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Ye kitab meri hai' mein 'ye' kya hai?
explanation: 'Ye' ishare ke liye aaya hai - ism-e-ishaara.

subject: Urdu
q: Zameer ki bunyadi khasiyat kya hai?
options: Ism ki jagah istemal hota hai
explanation: Zameer ism ka qaim-maqam hota hai.

subject: Urdu
q: Fe'l ki durust tareef kaun si hai?
options: Wo lafz jo kisi kaam ke karne, hone ya sehne ko kisi khaas zamane mein bataye
Shakhs ka naam batane wala lafz
explanation: Fe'l mein kaam + zamana dono hote hain.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Us ne khana khaya' mein fe'l kaun sa lafz hai?
explanation: 'Khaya' kaam ko guzre zamane mein batata hai - fe'l hai; 'khana' maf'ool hai.

subject: Urdu
q: Fe'l-e-Lazim kise kehte hain?
options: Jis ka fa'il maloom na ho
explanation: Lazim fe'l ko maf'ool ki zarurat nahin hoti, masalan 'wo sota hai'.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Bacha rota hai' mein fe'l kya hai?
explanation: 'Rota hai' ko kisi maf'ool ki zarurat nahin - fe'l-e-lazim.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Us ne seb khaya' mein fe'l kya hai?
explanation: 'Seb' maf'ool hai, is liye fe'l mutaddi hai.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Khat likha gaya' mein fe'l kya hai?
explanation: Fa'il maloom nahin, is liye fe'l-e-majhool hai.

subject: Urdu
q: Fe'l-e-Ma'roof ki pehchan kya hai?
explanation: Ma'roof mein fa'il maloom hota hai, masalan 'Ali ne khat likha'.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Ali ne khat likha' mein 'likha' kya hai?
explanation: Fa'il (Ali) maloom hai - fe'l-e-ma'roof.

subject: Urdu
q: Fe'l-e-Naqis kise kehte hain?
options: Jis se khabar ke baghair poora ma'ani na nikle
Jis ka fa'il maloom na ho
explanation: 'Hai, tha, hoga' naqis fe'l hain - khabar ke baghair adhoore lagte hain.

subject: Urdu
q: Darj zeel mein fe'l-e-naqis kaun sa hai?
explanation: 'Hai, tha, hoga' khabar chahte hain - fe'l-e-naqis.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Us ne khana khaya hai' mein kaun sa mazi hai?
explanation: 'Khaya hai' qareeb ke guzre zamane ko batata hai - mazi qareeb.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Us ne khana khaya tha' mein kaun sa mazi hai?
explanation: 'Khaya tha' door ke guzre zamane ko batata hai - mazi baeed.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Us ne khana khaya' (baghair 'hai' ya 'tha') mein kaun sa mazi hai?
explanation: Jis mein qareeb/baeed ka pata na chale - mazi mutlaq.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Wo khana khata tha' mein kaun sa mazi hai?
explanation: Jari rehne wale kaam ka bayan - mazi istimrari.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Agar wo aata to mein jata' mein fe'l kis mazi ki misaal hai?
explanation: Shart ('agar') par mabni mazi - mazi shartiya.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Kaash wo aa jata' mein kaun sa mazi hai?
explanation: Khwahish/tamanna ka izhar - mazi tamannai.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Shayad wo kal aaye' mein fe'l kis taraf ishara karta hai?
explanation: 'Shayad' shak ko zahir karta hai - mazi ihtemali.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Wo roz school jata hai' mein 'jata hai' kya zahir karta hai?
explanation: Roz ka mamool haal ka bayan hai.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Kal wo Lahore jayega' mein fe'l kaun se zamane mein hai?
explanation: 'Jayega' aane wale waqt ko batata hai - mustaqbil.

subject: Urdu
q: Harf ki durust tareef kaun si hai?
options: Kaam ko zamane mein batane wala lafz
Wo lafz jo apne ma'ani mein doosre lafz ka mohtaj ho
explanation: Harf khud mukammal ma'ani nahin deta - doosre lafz ka mohtaj hota hai.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Se, mein, par, ko, tak' kya kehlate hain?
explanation: Ye ism ko fe'l se jorte hain - haroof-e-jarr.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Mez par kitab hai' mein 'par' kya hai?
explanation: 'Par' ism (mez) ko jumle se jor raha hai - harf-e-jarr.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Aur, lekin, magar' kya kehlate hain?
explanation: Ye do lafzon/jumlon ko jorte hain - haroof-e-atf.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Aye dost! idhar aao' mein 'aye' kya hai?
explanation: Pukarne ke liye istemal hua - harf-e-nida.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Nahin, na, mat' kya kehlate hain?
explanation: Ye inkar ke liye aate hain - haroof-e-nafi.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Hi' aur 'bhi' (masalan 'wo hi aaya', 'tum bhi chalo') kya hain?
explanation: Ye baat par zor dete hain - haroof-e-ta'kid.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Agar, jab' qawaid ki ro se kya kehlate hain?
explanation: Ye shart lagate hain - haroof-e-shart.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Sa, si, jaisa' (masalan 'chand sa chehra') kya hain?
explanation: Ye mushabehat batate hain - haroof-e-tashbeeh.

subject: Urdu
q: Harf aur Harf-e-Tahajji mein bunyadi farq kya hai?
options: Harf kalma ki qism hai jabke harf-e-tahajji alif-be ka har ek harf hai
explanation: Harf ma'ani ke lihaz se kalma ki qism hai; harf-e-tahajji sirf abjad ka aik harf hai.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Wo ghar tak gaya' mein 'tak' kya hai?
explanation: 'Tak' had batata hai aur ism ko jorta hai - harf-e-jarr.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Ali aur Ahmed dost hain' mein 'aur' ka kaam kya hai?
explanation: 'Aur' do ismon ko jor raha hai - harf-e-atf.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Mat jao' mein 'mat' kya hai?
explanation: 'Mat' mana karne ke liye aaya - harf-e-nafi.

subject: Urdu
q: Kalma ki teeno aqsam mein se kaun si qism khud mukammal ma'ani NAHI deti?
explanation: Harf doosre lafz ka mohtaj hota hai; ism aur fe'l khud mukammal hain.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Kitab ke liye' mein 'ke liye' kya hai?
explanation: 'Ke liye' maqsad batata hai - harf-e-jarr ki qism.

subject: Urdu
q: Wahid aur jama mein bunyadi farq kya hai?
options: Wahid aik aur jama aik se zyada
explanation: Wahid aik cheez, jama aik se zyada cheezon ke liye.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Larka' ki jama kya hai?
explanation: Alif wale muzakkar lafz aam taur par 'e' lete hain: larka-larke.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Larki' ki jama kya hai?
explanation: 'I' wale mu'annas lafz 'iyan' lete hain: larki-larkiyan.

subject: Urdu

explanation: 'Bacha' ki jama 'bachche' hai - ye khaas qaida yaad rakho.

subject: Urdu

explanation: 'Waqt' ki jama-e-mukassar 'awqat' hai.

explanation: 'Shakhs' ki jama 'ashkhaas' hai.

explanation: 'Wazeer' ki jama-e-mukassar 'wuzara' hai.

explanation: 'Ameer' ki jama 'umara' hai.

explanation: 'Ustaad' ki mashhoor jama 'asatiza' hai.

explanation: 'Mulk' ki jama-e-mukassar 'mamaalik' hai.

subject: Urdu

explanation: 'Hakim' ki jama 'hukkaam' hai.

subject: Urdu
q: Jama-e-Salem aur Jama-e-Mukassar mein farq kya hai?

Salem Arabi aur mukassar Farsi hai
explanation: Salem = qaide wali jama; mukassar = shakl badalne wali jama.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Mez' ki jama kya hai?
explanation: 'Mez' ki jama-e-salem 'mezein' hai.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Darakht' ki jama kya hai?
explanation: 'Darakht' ki jama 'darakhton' hai.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Dost' ki jama kya hai?
explanation: 'Dost' ki jama 'doston' aur 'dostaan' dono mustamil hain.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Sheher' ki jama kya hai?
explanation: 'Sheher' ki jama-e-salem 'shehron' hai.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Qalam' muzakkar hai ya mu'annas?
explanation: 'Qalam' muzakkar hai - 'kala qalam' kehte hain.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Chaadar' muzakkar hai ya mu'annas?
explanation: 'Chaadar' mu'annas hai - 'safaid chaadar' kehte hain.

explanation: 'Darwaza' muzakkar hai - 'bara darwaza' kehte hain.

explanation: 'Khirki' mu'annas hai - 'khuli khirki' kehte hain.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Darya' muzakkar hai ya mu'annas?
explanation: 'Darya' muzakkar hai - 'gehra darya' kehte hain.

subject: Urdu

explanation: 'Kashti' mu'annas hai - 'tooti kashti' kehte hain.

subject: Urdu

explanation: 'Pani' 'i' par khatm hone ke bawajood muzakkar hai - 'thanda pani' kehte hain.

subject: Urdu

explanation: 'Dahi' muzakkar hai - 'khatta dahi' kehte hain.

explanation: 'Zabaan' mu'annas hai - 'meethi zabaan' kehte hain.

explanation: 'Awaaz' mu'annas hai - 'oonchi awaaz' kehte hain.

explanation: 'Suraj' aur 'Chand' dono muzakkar hain.

explanation: 'Tasveer' mu'annas hai - 'khoobsurat tasveer' kehte hain.

explanation: 'Ghee' muzakkar hai - 'khalis ghee' kehte hain.

q: 'Zaheen larka' tarkeeb ke lihaz se kya hai?
explanation: Sifat + mausoof ka murakkab - murakkab-e-tausifi.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Do kitabein' tarkeeb ke lihaz se kya hai?
explanation: Tadad batane wala murakkab - murakkab-e-adadi.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Maa-baap' tarkeeb ke lihaz se kya hai?
explanation: Atf se jura murakkab - murakkab-e-atfi.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Ali zaheen hai' mein 'Ali' qawaid ki ro se kya hai?
explanation: Jis ke baare mein kaha jaye wo mubtada hai; 'zaheen hai' khabar hai.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Subah', 'kal' aur 'aaj' qawaid ki ro se kya kehlate hain?
explanation: Ye waqt batate hain - zarf-e-zaman.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Iztirab' ka mutazad kaun sa lafz hai?
explanation: Iztirab (bechaini) ka mutazad sukoon (itminan) hai; ye jora recent papers mein aaya hai.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Dushman' ka mutazad kya hai?
explanation: Dushman ka mutazad dost hai; khasm bhi dushman ka mutaradif hai.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Subah' ka mutazad kaun sa hai?
explanation: Subah ka mutazad shaam hai; sawera subah ka mutaradif hai.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Tareeki' ka mutazad kya hai?
explanation: Tareeki (andhera) ka mutazad ujala hai.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Muhabbat' ka mutazad kaun sa lafz hai?
explanation: Muhabbat ka mutazad nafrat hai; ulfat aur wafa is ke mutaradif hain.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Shikast' ka mutazad kya hai?
explanation: Shikast (haar) ka mutazad fath hai; zafar fath ka mutaradif hai.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Jahalat' ka mutazad kaun sa hai?
explanation: Jahalat ka mutazad ilm hai; nadani jahalat ka mutaradif hai.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Ghareeb' ka mutazad kya hai?
explanation: Ghareeb ka mutazad ameer hai; fakeer ghareeb ka mutaradif hai.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Murda' ka mutazad kaun sa lafz hai?
explanation: Murda ka mutazad zinda hai.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Udaas' ka mutazad kya hai?
explanation: Udaas ka mutazad khush hai; ghamgeen udaas ka mutaradif hai.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Bad' ka mutazad kaun sa hai?
explanation: Bad ka mutazad naik hai; bura bad ka mutaradif hai.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Jhoot' ka mutazad kya hai?
explanation: Jhoot ka mutazad sach hai; fareb jhoot ka mutaradif hai.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Susti' ka mutazad kaun sa lafz hai?
explanation: Susti ka mutazad mehnat hai; kaahili susti ka mutaradif hai.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Tez' ka mutazad kya hai?
explanation: Tez ka mutazad ahista (sust) hai; chust tez ka mutaradif hai.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Thanda' ka mutazad kaun sa hai?
explanation: Thanda ka mutazad garam hai; sard thanda ka mutaradif hai.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Purana' ka mutazad kya hai?
explanation: Purana ka mutazad naya hai; qadeem purana ka mutaradif hai.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Bara' ka mutazad kaun sa lafz hai?
explanation: Bara ka mutazad chota hai; azeem bara ka mutaradif hai.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Tang' ka mutazad kya hai?
explanation: Tang ka mutazad wasee' (khula) hai.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Patla' ka mutazad kaun sa hai?
explanation: Patla ka mutazad mota hai; dubla patla ka mutaradif hai.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Door' ka mutazad kya hai?
explanation: Door ka mutazad qareeb hai.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Mushkil' ka mutazad kaun sa lafz hai?
explanation: Mushkil ka mutazad aasan hai; dushwar mushkil ka mutaradif hai.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Zyada' ka mutazad kya hai?
explanation: Zyada ka mutazad kam hai; kaseer zyada ka mutaradif hai.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Haram' ka mutazad kaun sa hai?
explanation: Haram ka mutazad halal hai; na-jaiz haram ka mutaradif hai.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Zulm' ka mutazad kya hai?
explanation: Zulm ka mutazad insaf hai; sitam zulm ka mutaradif hai.

subject: Urdu

explanation: Jang ka mutazad aman hai; harb jang ka mutaradif hai.

subject: Urdu

explanation: Barbadi ka mutazad falah (kamyabi) hai; tabahi barbadi ka mutaradif hai.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Sakhti' ka mutazad kaun sa hai?
explanation: Sakhti ka mutazad narmi hai.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Buzdili' ka mutazad kya hai?
explanation: Buzdili ka mutazad jurrat hai; dar buzdili ka mutaradif hai.

subject: Urdu

subject: Urdu
q: 'Bimari' ka mutazad kya hai?
explanation: Bimari ka mutazad sehat hai; marz bimari ka mutaradif hai.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Ghurbat' ka mutazad kaun sa hai?
explanation: Ghurbat ka mutazad daulat hai; faqr ghurbat ka mutaradif hai.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Mayusi' ka mutazad kya hai?
explanation: Mayusi ka mutazad umeed hai; na-umeedi mayusi ka mutaradif hai.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Intiha' ka mutazad kaun sa lafz hai?
explanation: Intiha ka mutazad ibtida hai; aakhir intiha ka mutaradif hai.

subject: Urdu
q: 'Posheeda' ka mutazad kya hai?
explanation: Posheeda ka mutazad zahir hai; makhfi posheeda ka mutaradif hai.

subject: Urdu

explanation: Andar ka mutazad bahir hai; kharij bhi bahir ka mutaradif hai.

explanation: Peeche ka mutazad aage hai; aqab peeche ka mutaradif hai.

explanation: Band ka mutazad khula hai; muqaffal band ka mutaradif hai.

explanation: Karwa ka mutazad meetha hai; talkh karwa ka mutaradif hai.

subject: Urdu

explanation: Ganda ka mutazad saaf hai; maila ganda ka mutaradif hai.

explanation: Mashaqqat mehnat ka mutaradif hai.
